Ch. 2. 1</ls>. .²2 Associated, connected. .²3 Manifold, diverse; प्रसूतिमिश्राः स्त्रिय उद्विग्नचित्ता ऊचुर्विपाको वृजिनस्यैष तस्य <ls>Bhāg. 4. 5. 9</ls>. .²4 Tangled, intertwined. .²5 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Having a mixture of, consisting for the most part of. .²6 Mixing, adulterating. .{@-श्रः@} .²1 A respectable or worthy person; usually affixed to the names of great men and scholars; आर्यमिश्राः प्रमाणम् <ls>M. 1</ls>; वसिष्ठमिश्रः; मण्डनमिश्रः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A kind of elephant. .²3 The group of the constellations कृत्तिका and विशाखा. .²4 (In music) A kind of measure. .{@-श्रम्@} .²1 A mixture. .²2 A kind of radish. .²3 (with धन) Principal and interest.
